trans-unit.source: Bal nikada nije bio samo ples.
trans-unit.target: A ball has always been more than a dance.

trans-unit.source: Reč „bal“ javlja se još u XII veku, a poreklo vodi od latinskog ballare — igrati.
trans-unit.target: The word ball can be traced back to the twelfth century and derives from the Latin ballare — to dance.

trans-unit.source: Takva mesta vremenom su dobijala značaj daleko veći od svoje prvobitne namene. U njima se razvijao kulturni život, povezivali ljudi i rađale ideje čiji je značaj trajao mnogo duže od jedne večeri.
trans-unit.target: Over time, such places came to hold a significance far beyond their original purpose. Within their walls, cultural life flourished, relationships were formed and ideas took shape whose influence extended well beyond a single evening.

trans-unit.source: Bila su to mesta na kojima su se različite kulture približavale i na kojima su iz susreta nastajale veze koje su nadživljavale pojedinačne svečanosti.
trans-unit.target: They became places where different cultures drew closer and where encounters gave rise to connections that endured long after the celebrations had ended.

trans-unit.source: U tom duhu nastaje i Sretenjski bal u Mariboru — kao susret srpske i slovenačke kulture i početak jedne nove tradicije.
trans-unit.target: In this same spirit, Sretenjski bal takes shape in Maribor — as an encounter between Serbian and Slovenian culture and the beginning of a new tradition.
Kragujevac, the court of Prince Miloš

trans-unit.source: Prvi bal u Kneževini Srbiji održan je 1834. godine u Kragujevcu, na dvoru kneza Miloša.
trans-unit.target: The first ball in the Principality of Serbia was held in 1834 in Kragujevac, at the court of Prince Miloš.

trans-unit.source: U decenijama koje su usledile, balovi su postali važna mesta susreta, razgovora, povezivanja i dogovora. Okupljali su ljude iz sveta politike, kulture, privrede i umetnosti, dok su se na dobrotvornim balovima prikupljala sredstva za škole, društva i druge javne potrebe.
trans-unit.target: In the decades that followed, balls became important occasions for social gatherings, conversation, connection and the exchange of ideas. They brought together figures from politics, culture, business and the arts, while charity balls raised funds for schools, societies and other public causes.

trans-unit.source: I u slovenačkim zemljama ples je odavno bio sastavni deo građanskog i društvenog života. Do tada se balska kultura razvijala u građanskim krugovima, često pod snažnim nemačkim i austrijskim kulturnim uticajem.
trans-unit.target: In the Slovenian lands, dancing had long been an established part of civic and social life. Until then, the culture of balls had developed largely within the bourgeois circles of the period, often under strong German and Austrian cultural influence.

trans-unit.source: Od šezdesetih godina XIX veka počinje da se razvija mreža slovenskih čitalnica.
trans-unit.target: From the 1860s onwards, a network of Slovenian reading rooms, known as čitalnice, began to emerge.

trans-unit.source: Na svečanom otvaranju čitalnice u Kranju 1863. godine, nakon izvođenja pesme „Hej Slovani“, usledio je ples kojim je svečanost završena.
trans-unit.target: At the opening of the reading room in Kranj in 1863, a performance of the song “Hej, Slovani” was followed by dancing, which brought the celebration to a close.

trans-unit.source: Čitalnice nisu bile samo mesta za čitanje knjiga. U njima su se ljudi okupljali, slušali muziku, prisustvovali predstavama i predavanjima, ali i učestvovali u plesnim svečanostima.
trans-unit.target: Reading rooms were far more than places devoted to books. They offered opportunities for gathering, listening to music, attending theatrical performances and lectures, and taking part in dances and other social occasions.

trans-unit.source: U Mariboru je ta ideja dobila svoj dom
trans-unit.target: In Maribor, this idea found its home

trans-unit.source: Godine 1898. podignut je Narodni dom, središte kulturnog i društvenog života mariborskih Slovenaca. Pod njegovim krovom svoje mesto pronašli su čitaonica, biblioteka, muzička i dramska društva, dok su se u svečanoj dvorani održavali koncerti, predstave, skupovi i plesovi.
trans-unit.target: Built in 1898, Narodni dom became a centre of cultural and social life for the Slovenian community of Maribor. It housed a reading room, a library, and musical and dramatic societies, while its ceremonial hall welcomed concerts, theatrical performances, public gatherings and dances.

trans-unit.source: Bal nikada nije bio samo ples: od latinskog ballare, preko prvog bala u Kragujevcu i slovenačkih čitalnica, do Narodnog doma u Mariboru.
trans-unit.target: A ball was never just a dance: from the Latin ballare, through the first ball in Kragujevac and the Slovenian reading rooms, to the Narodni dom in Maribor.

trans-unit.source: Prvi Sretenjski bal organizuje Kulturni centar Sretenje, inicijativa nastala iz želje da građanska kultura i njene pomalo zaboravljene vrednosti ponovo dobiju svoje mesto u savremenom društvu.
trans-unit.target: The inaugural Sretenjski bal is organised by Kulturni centar Sretenje, an initiative born of a desire to restore the place of a somewhat forgotten civic culture and its values in contemporary society.

trans-unit.source: Tokom istorije, srpska zajednica na ovim prostorima ostavljala je trag u kulturi, obrazovanju, privredi i duhovnom životu. Naša je namera da to nasleđe približimo savremenom trenutku — ne kao povratak u prošlost, već kao temelj za ono što ćemo tek stvarati.
trans-unit.target: Throughout history, the Serbian community in this region has left its mark on culture, education, commerce and spiritual life. Our intention is to bring this heritage into the present — not as a return to the past, but as a foundation for what is yet to be created.

trans-unit.source: Kulturni centar Sretenje zamišljen je kao trajno mesto okupljanja ljudi iz sveta kulture, nauke, privrede i duhovnog života — mesto razgovora, povezivanja i novih ideja. Njegova je namera da neguje sopstveno nasleđe i istovremeno gradi odnose sa kulturnom sredinom u kojoj deluje.
trans-unit.target: Kulturni centar Sretenje is envisioned as an enduring place of gathering for people from the worlds of culture, science, business and spiritual life. It seeks to encourage conversation, foster meaningful connections and give rise to new ideas, while preserving its own heritage and cultivating lasting relationships with the cultural community in which it operates.

trans-unit.source: U imenu Sretenje sadržana je suština ove zamisli: susret duhovnog i građanskog, tradicije i savremenosti, našeg nasleđa i kulture sredine u kojoj živimo. Verujemo da upravo iz takvih susreta nastaju nove veze i trajna prijateljstva.
trans-unit.target: The name Sretenje embodies the very idea upon which the Centre was founded: a meeting of the spiritual and the civic, of tradition and modernity, of our own heritage and the culture of the place we call home. We believe that such encounters give rise to new connections and enduring friendships.

trans-unit.source: Sretenjski bal prvi je korak ka ostvarenju te zamisli.
trans-unit.target: Sretenjski bal marks the first step towards realising this vision.

trans-unit.source: Imena ostalih učesnika programa biće uskoro objavljena.
trans-unit.target: Further programme participants will be announced in due course.

trans-unit.source: Neke večeri ostaju u sećanju. Neke označe početak nove tradicije.
trans-unit.target: Some evenings live on in memory. Others mark the beginning of a tradition.

trans-unit.source: Krajem XIX veka, u Mariboru, gde su Slovenci bili manjina, nastala je zamisao o domu koji će čuvati slovenački jezik, kulturu i zajedništvo. Iz te zamisli nastao je Narodni dom.
trans-unit.target: In the late nineteenth century, when Slovenes formed a minority in Maribor, the idea emerged of establishing a home dedicated to preserving the Slovenian language, culture and sense of community. From this vision, Narodni dom was born.

trans-unit.source: U zdanju koje pamti brojne susrete započinje jedan novi.
trans-unit.target: In a building that has witnessed generations of encounters, another is about to begin.

trans-unit.source: Narodni dom, podignut prema projektu češkog arhitekte Jana Vejrycha u stilu češke neorenesanse, počinje da radi 1. oktobra.
trans-unit.target: Designed by the Czech architect Jan Vejrych in the Czech Neo-Renaissance style, Narodni dom opened its doors on 1 October.

trans-unit.source: U velikoj dvorani osnovano je Slovenačko pozorište u Mariboru.
trans-unit.target: The Slovenian Theatre in Maribor was founded in the great hall.

trans-unit.source: U Domu je osnovan Narodni savet za Štajersku.
trans-unit.target: The National Council for Styria was established in Narodni dom.

trans-unit.source: Narodni dom ponovo postaje kulturni centar grada.
trans-unit.target: Narodni dom once again became a cultural centre of the city.

trans-unit.source: Reč „bal“ potiče od latinskog ballare — igrati. Tokom vekova balovi su bili mnogo više od plesnih svečanosti: predstavljali su priliku za susrete, razgovore, povezivanje i dogovore. Na dobrotvornim balovima prikupljala su se sredstva za škole, društva i druge javne potrebe.
trans-unit.target: The word ball derives from the Latin ballare — to dance. Throughout history, balls have been more than occasions for dancing. They have brought people together for conversation, connection and the exchange of ideas, while charity balls have raised funds for schools, societies and other public causes.

trans-unit.source: Reč „sretenje“ u srpskom i slovenačkom jeziku znači susret. U simbolici ovog praznika prepliću se duhovno predanje, narodna verovanja i istorijsko nasleđe.
trans-unit.target: In Serbian and Slovenian, the word sretenje carries the meaning of an encounter. The symbolism of the feast brings together spiritual tradition, folk beliefs and historical heritage.

trans-unit.source: Vere i istorije.Zime i proleća.Prošlosti i budućnosti.
trans-unit.target: Of faith and history.Of winter and spring.Of past and future.

trans-unit.source: Na toj ideji počiva i Sretenjski bal, zamišljen kao susret srpske i slovenačke kulture.
trans-unit.target: It is upon this idea that Sretenjski bal is founded — as an encounter between Serbian and Slovenian culture.

trans-unit.source: Prema Jevanđelju po Luki, četrdesetog dana po Isusovom rođenju, Marija i Josif doneli su ga u jerusalimski hram. Tamo ga je starac Simeon uzeo u naručje i prepoznao kao svetlost.
trans-unit.target: According to the Gospel of Luke, forty days after the birth of Jesus, Mary and Joseph brought the child to the Temple in Jerusalem. There, the elder Simeon took him in his arms and recognised him as the light.

trans-unit.source: U narodnom predanju Sretenje se vezuje za simbolični susret zime i proleća.
trans-unit.target: In folk tradition, Sretenje symbolises the meeting of winter and spring.

trans-unit.source: Na Sretenje je u Orašcu podignut Prvi srpski ustanak, čime je započeta borba za oslobođenje Srbije od osmanske vlasti.
trans-unit.target: On Sretenje, the First Serbian Uprising began in Orašac, marking the beginning of the struggle to liberate Serbia from Ottoman rule.

trans-unit.source: U Kragujevcu je proglašen Sretenjski ustav, kojim su prvi put jasno postavljeni temelji moderne srpske države.
trans-unit.target: The Sretenje Constitution was proclaimed in Kragujevac, laying down, for the first time, the foundations of the modern Serbian state.

trans-unit.source: Sretenje je Dan državnosti Republike Srbije.
trans-unit.target: Since 2002, Sretenje has been celebrated as Statehood Day of the Republic of Serbia.
